spec.rawIntent: The three handlers in src/handlers (createUser, updateUser, inviteUser) each carry their own copy of the email and name validation. Refactor: move the validation into one module, src/validation.js, exporting `validateEmail(value)` and `validateName(value)`, each returning null when the value is valid and the error message otherwise, and make all three handlers use it. Behaviour must not change: the same inputs give the same results, error messages included. Keep the existing tests passing and add tests for the new module.
